run_filter_hf_dataset: run the script to filter a parquet HF dataset and push the result to the hub
create_slurm_pipeline_executor: create a SlurmPipelineExecutor with a pipeline of ParquetReader, LambdaFilter, and HuggingFaceDatasetWriter
build_parquet_reader: build a ParquetReader to load a parquet-format Hugging Face dataset from the hub
create_lambda_filter: create a LambdaFilter that filters dataset entries containing a specified word in the text column
create_huggingface_dataset_writer: create a HuggingFaceDatasetWriter to push a filtered dataset back to the Hugging Face hub
